name: PRImA Layout Analysis Dataset: Contemporary Document Benchmark
description: The PRImA Layout Analysis Dataset is a foundational benchmark dataset for evaluating physical and logical document layout analysis algorithms. Developed by the Pattern Recognition & Image Analysis (PRImA) Research Lab at the University of Salford, the dataset comprises 478 realistic contemporary document pages drawn primarily from magazines, scientific journals, and technical publications characterized by complex multi-column layouts, varied typography, embedded graphics, and decorative backgrounds. Each page is paired with comprehensive ground truth encoded in the widely adopted PAGE (Page Analysis and Ground Truth Elements) XML schema, specifying polygonal region boundaries, reading orders, and logical text classifications.
